description: the tie of the split order (ADR-0009): boolean/cross-cylinders-common — the Steinmetz solid of two cylinders of radius R crossing at the origin, 16R³/3 — rebuilt at three radii and lengths and one more turn of the tool. Each wall is cut into a lens on each side of the crossing, and the lens a seam runs through is two faces on either side of that seam: those two are bounded by the same origins, so only the tiebreak in the origin face's own (u, v) orders them. The variants keep every piece on its side of the origin

analytic.counts_differ: as boolean/cross-cylinders-common: Open CASCADE also cuts the section arc that runs through the second ellipse's parameter origin there, one more vertex and edge; Arris's edge range crosses the period once (E1)
